description: A native desktop Matrix client: Qt 6 on top of the official Rust Matrix SDK
notes: User data (account stores, crypto store, cache) is kept in the app's persist folder, so upgrades and reinstalls keep your data.
On first install, an existing %LOCALAPPDATA%\MatrixClient\matrix-client folder is copied into persist/data once and then left alone.
Windows packages are unsigned, so SmartScreen warns on first launch.
post_install: $dest = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'MatrixClient\matrix-client'; $target = Join-Path $dir 'data'; if ((Test-Path $dest) -and -not (Test-Path $target)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $target -Force | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem $dest -Force | Copy-Item -Destination $target -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
